summary: This theme consolidates research on the perceptions, challenges, and dynamics of integrating AI (including generative AI and LLMs) in language education, addressing issues like teacher-student collaboration, trust, fairness, and the balance between human and AI agency.

This theme examines the interplay between AI tools and pedagogical principles in language education, focusing on learner agency, feedback systems, writing instruction, and the tensions between traditional methods and technological innovation.

This theme explores the role of AI-generated feedback, learner prompting behaviors, and the dual impact of tools like ChatGPT on autonomy, metacognition, and skill development, while addressing challenges like reliability and user proficiency.

theme_label: Adoption Factors of AI in Education
summary: This theme highlights the determinants of AI adoption in language education, including motivation, emotional responses, cultural context, and perceived risks, as well as the role of institutional support in shaping acceptance.
